settings.backupHint: One file with your products, history and settings.
settings.backupMergeHint: Keeps what you have and adds what is missing.
settings.backupReplaceHint: Erases what is on this device first.
settings.backupInvalid: That file isn’t a Sooda backup.
settings.ratesAutoHint: Downloads a small public rates file from Sooda’s own site. Nothing from your device is sent.
settings.ratesOffline: Using the copy that came with the app — updates are off or not reachable.
settings.ratesMissing: No national figures yet, so Sooda is going on the prices you record.
